title: Looks okay
text: Looks okay. It's exactly as the one on the picture but I am worried about durability, the handles look very cheap and make picking it up very heavy and difficult in my opinion, the handles could be better. That being said I mostly bought this because I wanted it for small spaces and easy storage, this bag fills all those standards for that purpose. It's really very convenient and easy to move around anyway because of the small legs at the bottom, specially if you have a hard floor (which I don't but just saying), it doesn't use a lot of space and can easily be stored in your closet and it's not very heavy so it's easy to move around. The only downside I see is that it does already come with limited space for the clothes and then to top that off it has this mesh bag at the top that seems to be glued on and unable to take off, this mesh part at the top makes it almost impossible to even fill the bag completely and only lets you carry a certain amount of clothes at a time, which is, mind you, not a lot, given the already reduced space. I think the mesh bag at the top is unnecessary because it's not even a complete mesh bag it's just like the top part that is this way and doesn't really serve any purpose if you ask me, it's supposed to help to close it but really not necessary.  Comparing it to a much cheaper version of another laundry bag I bought alongside with this I'd say it's only worth it if what you want is easier storage like myself.
